story.title: DeepMind's David Silver raises $1.1B to build AI that learns without any human-generated data
story.summary: Ineffable Intelligence, a British AI lab founded just months ago by former DeepMind researcher David Silver — the scientist behind AlphaGo — has raised $1.1 billion at a $5.1 billion valuation. The lab's stated goal is to build AI systems that can learn entirely without human-generated training data, a fundamental departure from how most current AI models are built. If successful, the approach could remove one of the core bottlenecks in AI development: the finite and often biased supply of human-labelled data.
